runtimeAuthority: Existing versioned editable catalog + existing FX snapshot. These source snapshot amounts are validation evidence only, NOT prices to render.
offsetContract: Half-open UTF-16 indices for JS slicing AND UTF-8 byte offsets. Verify field/unit hashes first. Replacements apply from highest start offset downward per field, preserving untouched authored bytes; never String.replaceAll(amount).
mirrorContract: Price-bind factBlockMarkdown and faq[].answerMarkdown mirrors using these exact spans. Render body FAQ OR accordion once; FAQ schema may reuse its mirrored answers. SEO description is included. USD slots map to the SAME operation as preceding IDR span.
sharedVariantContract: Resolve BOTH variants from the SAME catalog and FX versions. Emit a single amount only when exact Decimal IDR totals and existing display projections match. Otherwise split explicitly labelled D1/D2 variants or block rendering/publication; never silently select D1.
fxContract: Reuse existing Indodax/cache/fallback/Decimal and nearest-$5 helpers; do not add an amount-to-USD converter. Two-stage totals use existing composition plumbing before display rounding.
publicationContract: Missing, stale, mismatched versions, or divergent shared variants block public rendering/publication or require explicitly labelled variant presentation; never fallback silently to authored amount/token.
